top_patents.abstract: [0000]    A Low Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) technique is provided to produce improved dielectric/semiconductor interfaces for GaN-based electronic devices. Using the LPCVD technique, superior interfaces are achieved through the use of elevated deposition temperatures (>700° C.), the use of ammonia to stabilize and clean the GaN surface, and chlorine-containing precursors where reactions with chlorine remove unwanted impurities from the dielectric film and its interface with GaN. top_patents.title: Semiconductor wafer doping characterization system based on exciton absorption principle
top_patents.abstract: The invention discloses a semiconductor wafer doping characterization system based on an exciton absorption principle. The semiconductor wafer doping characterization system has great application prospects in the fields of semiconductor doping characterization and semiconductor device physical research. The system is composed of a semiconductor sample with exciton absorption characteristics, an excitation light source, an optical microscopic system, a system imaging unit and a computer.
